scenes.title: One job to do
scenes.narration: You want to give an AI agent one job. Research a market. Prepare a launch. Move the business forward.

scenes.title: Six setup jobs
scenes.narration: But before the work begins, you're choosing models, connecting company knowledge, adding skills, shaping behavior, wiring services, and setting up payments.

scenes.title: Scattered context
scenes.narration: The brief lives in one place. The documents live somewhere else. Every new agent asks for context you have already given.

scenes.title: The human coordinator
scenes.narration: More agents mean more handoffs. Different instructions. Missing sources. Conflicting answers. You become the coordinator.

scenes.title: Spend and responsibility
scenes.narration: And now, agents can spend. Which service was paid? What did inference cost? Who approved it? A useful answer is only part of the job.

scenes.title: The hidden work
scenes.narration: The result? More setup. More copying. More supervision. Less time doing the work that matters.

scenes.title: What businesses need
scenes.narration: Businesses need agents that share the right context, have clear responsibilities, and work within visible limits.

scenes.title: The real goal
scenes.narration: Because the goal is not to manage more AI tools. It's to get real work done.
